description: Source code for cursor management in the Wesnoth game, including cursor creation, caching, drawing, and focus handling.

classes.name: cursor::manager
classes.description: Manages cursor state, including setting cursor type, focus, and cleanup.

classes.name: cursor::setter
classes.description: RAII class for temporarily setting a cursor type and restoring previous on destruction.

methods.name: use_colour
methods.description: Enables or disables colour cursors based on user preferences and editor mode.

methods.name: set_focus
methods.description: Sets whether the cursor has focus.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the colour cursor on the screen at the current mouse position.

methods.name: undraw
methods.description: Restores the screen area where the cursor was drawn.
